name: AIPL Lake City
summary: The project, developer (AIPL), Sector 103 Dwarka Expressway location, the December 2030 possession date, the ~₹3.5–3.6 Cr starting price and the 2,200–2,800 sq ft 3/4 BHK sizes are confirmed. Our RERA number GGM/844/576/2024/71 appears only on broker microsites. Other sources give different numbers for the township's phases: GGM/718/450/2023/127, GGM/823/555/2024/50, and GGM/1019/751/2025/122 for Riviera, the phase actually launched in Dec 2025. Land area (30 acres vs 53 acres for the township) and towers/units (7/800 vs Riviera's 2 towers/~344 units) depend on which phase is meant.

checks.web: AIPL Lake City integrated township, Sector 103, Dwarka Expressway; first launched phase marketed as 'The Riviera at AIPL Lake City'
checks.note: HARERA allowed Riviera registration despite a pending land dispute, with units on disputed land frozen from sale. Investors may want this mentioned.

checks.web: AIPL (promoters include AIPL Bharat Infrastructure Pvt Ltd for Riviera, Floralessence Projects Pvt Ltd for Aquaria)
checks.note: Our 'listed as' label uses the project name rather than the company name (cosmetic).

checks.ours: Sector 103, Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram, Sector 103, Haryana

checks.web: GGM/844/576/2024/71 (broker microsite aiplthelakecity.com only); other sources: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/718/450/2023/127, RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/823/555/2024/50, GGM/1019/751/2025/122 (Riviera, registered 08.12.2025; HARERA ID RERA-GRG-2085-2025)
checks.note: Our number could not be confirmed on HARERA or a major portal; only a broker microsite quotes it. The township has several registrations, and the launched Riviera phase uses GGM/1019/751/2025/122. Verify on haryanarera.gov.in before relying on it.

December 2030 (per RERA filing, per Togetherbuying and aiplthelakecity.com); 'expected by 2029' (Megarealtymax)

checks.web: 3 BHK 2,200 sq ft; 3 BHK Type 1 2,400 sq ft; 4 BHK + Servant 2,800 sq ft (aiplthelakecity.com). Riviera phase: 2 BHK+Study 2,053–2,308, 3 BHK+Study 2,196, 3 BHK+Utility 2,398–2,869, 4 BHK 3,211 sq ft (Togetherbuying)

checks.web: 17 acres Phase 1 / 30 acres planned (aiplthelakecity.com); 53 acres, expandable to 80, township (Megarealtymax, Togetherbuying); Riviera ~5.13 acres
checks.note: Sources disagree; most describe a 53-acre township.

checks.web: 7 towers, 25 floors, 800 units (aiplthelakecity.com); 710 units in Phase 1 with 46-storey towers (Megarealtymax); Riviera: 2 towers of G+43, ~332–500 units
checks.note: Only a broker microsite states the same values; the registered Riviera phase is far smaller.
